Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Ready to accelerate your career?
Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.
Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.
We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

We're looking for an Operations Analyst to provide crucial foundational support for our daily fintech operations, helping us scale efficiently and maintain regulatory compliance. This entry-level position is designed for someone eager to learn and grow within a fast-paced fintech environment, playing a key role in continuous process improvement and smooth business execution.
Manage daily operational tasks and ensure the seamless execution of processes, utilizing platforms like Slack and Google Drive to coordinate across teams.
Assist in critical onboarding procedures, including KYC, KYB, and AML checks, ensuring strict compliance with internal policies and financial regulations.
Execute data entry and maintain accurate operational systems, records, and documentation.
Identify bottlenecks in current workflows and recommend actionable changes to streamline and automate operations.
Assist in generating reports related to operational performance and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), escalating concerns or delays to senior team members as needed.
Collaborate cross-functionally to provide operational support to departments such as customer service, risk, and finance, ensuring issues are resolved and workflows remain efficient.
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of attention to detail and the ability to handle repetitive tasks efficiently.
Proficiency in spreadsheet formulas (filters, tables, pivot tables) and the ability to create and manage clear presentations.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal stakeholders.
Strong time management abilities to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Adaptability to fast-changing environments and a strong willingness to learn.
Experience or interest in using AI tools to automate and improve workflows.

Prior experience in administrative roles, customer service, or operational tasks.
Basic knowledge of financial regulations and internal compliance policies.
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, Python, or data visualization tools like Metabase .
A good sense of humor.

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.
Who we are
We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .
Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.
Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.
Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.
Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.
What we believe in
#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.
#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

s.h: #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.
s.t:
#Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.
#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.
#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

s.h: Competitive salary and stock options ( ESOP ) from day one
s.t:
Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)
Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths
High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together
Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact
Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results
If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.
Clara’s Hybrid Policy
Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.
We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Secret Media Network is a digital entertainment and media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta and More!

We are looking for an Business Operations Manager with a structured mindset, who loves to improve efficiency in everything and help scale and optimize operations across Secret Media Network. This role will be fully focused on designing, implementing, and improving processes that drive efficiency, scalability, and performance across the organization.

Process Design & Optimization
Design, implement, and continuously improve operational workflows across SMN.
Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas of improvement, and translate them into scalable processes.
Standardize ways of working to ensure consistency and predictability in execution between different regions: North America, Europe, APAC, Latam
AI Automation & Tooling
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using AI tools and internal systems.
Collaborate with Tech/Data teams to implement scalable solutions.
Leverage AI tools to improve productivity and execution speed.
Operational Excellence
Partner with stakeholders to ensure processes are adopted and correctly implemented.
Document and maintain clear operational playbooks.
Strategic Collaboration
Work closely with Marketing, Product, Data, and Local teams to align operations with business needs.
Act as a bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring operational feasibility.
Align the organization's business needs with technological and operational solutions by managing critical tools and procedures
Performance & Metrics
Define and track KPIs related to operational efficiency (e.g., post production time, output, quality).
Use data to identify improvement opportunities and drive decision-making.

You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Analytics (STEM degree)
5+ years of experience in strategy/operations consulting, supply chain, media operations, marketing operations, or production management — ideally in large-scale, fast-paced, digital-first organizations.
Strong experience in process design, optimization, and workflow automation.
Comfortable working with data and defining KPIs to measure performance.
Hands-on mindset: able to move from strategy to execution quickly.
Experience with automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Notion, Airtable, etc.) is a strong plus.
Familiarity with AI tools and interest in leveraging them for operational efficiency.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is a must

s.h: Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
s.t:
40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).

s.h: Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
s.t:
Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes. You can also pay for an upgrade to manage your Beckham Law application, along with other tax-related procedures.
Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Having many products and countries, we need to make sure everything runs smoothly. As the operation team, we help supervise operations across Fever teams and identify and prioritize needs. Our goal is to help Fever grow, increasing the efficiency in our ways of working and maintaining a best-in-class experience for all stakeholders.
We are seeking a highly motivated, organized, and adaptable individual to join our company as an Operations Support Specialist. You will play a crucial role within the global operations team, ensuring smooth workflows by managing vendor communications, purchase orders, and payment tracking.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams such as Procurement and Finance, gaining a comprehensive view of our global operations while providing essential administrative support that allows our strategic and analytical teams to focus on growth.
Your proactive nature, flexible "think outside the box" mindset, and ability to efficiently manage and prioritize backlogs are exactly what we are looking for.

We are looking for an Operations Support Specialist who loves to keep pipelines clean, prioritize effectively, and always finds a way to get things done! Some of your responsibilities will include:
Global Operations Support: Act as the operational backbone of the team by managing essential daily workflows and ensuring our global pipeline runs seamlessly and efficiently.
Vendor Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new suppliers, maintaining constant communication with vendors to gather requirements and collaborating closely with Procurement.
Order & PO Tracking: Follow up on purchase orders and merchandising requests, ensuring constant alignment between external vendors and internal teams to keep deliveries on track.
Invoicing & Payments: Track vendor invoices and collaborate with the Finance team to guarantee on-time payments, proactively preventing any service blockages.
Prioritization & SLA Management: Analyze incoming requests and exercise good judgment to prioritize issues that pose a business risk, efficiently managing the backlog to meet strict SLAs.

1+ year of experience in operations, support, or a fast-paced coordination role.
Highly organized and proactive , capable of managing a high volume of tasks, backlogs, and deadlines simultaneously.
Flexible and solution-oriented , with a "think outside the box" mentality and the ability to adapt easily to a dynamic, strategic environment.
Clear and effective communicator who feels comfortable chasing international vendors and aligning with internal teams (Procurement, Finance).
Comfortable managing operational tools, tracking databases, and maintaining clean pipelines.

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Legal
As the legal team, we support all areas of Fever by offering scalable legal support – clear advice , risk management , and legal insight – that allow teams to move quickly and stay focused on what matters.
Our team is structured in:l Intellectual Property , Commercial, Strategic Transactions, Privacy, Dispute Resolution, and Legal Operations. Together, we cover the full legal landscape to meet the needs of a growing global business like Fever.
Join us if you are ready to tackle global challenges and provide strategic legal leadership to protect the long-term success of a rapidly growing tech leader.

We have an exciting opportunity for a candidate with a strong background in team leadership and knowledge management to join the Fever Legal GRC & Policy Team, here in Madrid, to manage our tech-enabled legal operations function.

We’re looking for applicants who are interested in shaping the future of Legal Operations at Fever, to remain cornerstone for sophisticated, value-driven and quick dealmaking at scale, and for effective and savvy risk management and seamless integration with company-wide tools and processes.
As a Legal Operations Manager, you will be a strategic leader responsible for driving the underpinning knowledge management for efficient, consistent, tech-scaled legal work, and championing operational excellence across the function aligning department-wide operations with broader business objectives.

This role sets the strategic priorities of our Legal Operations function, oversees the range of functions performed by the Legal Operations team, and involves the day-to-day management of team members.

s.h: In the first 60 days you will
s.t:
Meet the Legal Operations professionals who report directly or indirectly to the manager to establish working relationships and understand individual’s roles, strengths, and objectives
Understand current operational touchpoints, hand in hand with the Legal Operations team members and key stakeholders (including the Legal teams and Risk functions, as well as with relevant business functions)
Gain a thorough understanding of the existing legal technology stack, knowledge management systems, and current workflows, through both individual inquiry and participation in the existing initiatives and processes related to them
Build communication forums and practices with other individuals involved in designing, developing and/or in delivering operational solutions for the department, including AI Enablement, Business Operations, Privacy Operations, and beyond
Familiarize yourself with Fever’s global businesses and footprint, the legal landscape, corporate policies, and strategic business objectives
Review the current Legal function’s spending processes, and vendor relationships, creating systems to improve tracking, global law firm and related vendor (notarial, etc) management and billing practices

s.h: In the first 180 days you will
s.t:
Define objectives and KPIs for the Legal Operations team and establish a framework for tracking and reporting on operational metrics
Refine knowledge management structures and documentation standards to support efficient and consistent legal service delivery
Gain a thorough understanding of the existing workflows, knowledge and technology of the functions that legal and risk teams serve across the company, including Finance, Business Development, Media, Corporate Development and others
Become an active contributor to one or more ongoing initiatives in the implementation of tech-enabled processes across the department
Initiate a high-impact, quick-win project (e.g., streamlining a key administrative process or piloting a feature of an existing tech tool), building momentum and a practical understanding of change management
Become familiarized with the knowledge management, technology stack and current workflows of risk functions (Safety & Security, Insurance, etc)

Be a strategic leader of the Legal Operations function, evolving the strategic roadmap to drive sustained operational excellence at a global scale.
Oversee and enhance critical functional areas, including knowledge management, case support and documentation systems, and administrative functions within the team.
Evaluate, implement, and champion the adoption of emerging legal technologies, including AI and automation tools, to elevate the quality, speed, and scalability of the legal function.
Create and monitor department budgets, track spending, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
Manage a team of paralegals and legal operations staff, including empowering and mentoring coordinators within the team, conducting performance reviews, and driving their professional development.
Serve as a key liaison between the legal department and other business functions, acting with executive presence to influence stakeholders and ensuring alignment with company goals.

Have 3+ years of experience in innovation, knowledge management or tech implementation, including proven people management experience (bonus points for experience working with international teams and projects)..
Have prior experience as a lawyer, either in-house or in law firms, preferably through several legal fields, or can demonstrate a good understanding of the complexities related to the operational needs of disparate fields of legal work.
Are capable of learning through a self-motivated pursuit of the right questions, information and answers to acquire new skills as evolving environments require.
Demonstrate expertise in at least three of these areas: knowledge management, AI implementation, legal technology tools, process improvement, and operational management.
Have strong leadership and mentoring skills, strategic vision, and excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including cultural awareness, and empathy, along with the executive presence necessary to interact confidently with senior leadership.
Are professionally fluent in English (any other language can be a plus but is not required).

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

This is your chance to shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact part of Gusto's business as a Senior Sales Operations Analyst supporting our Health Insurance (HI) Sales team. You'll build the insights and AI-powered solutions that make a large, high-volume sales organization, supporting 80+ reps across two segments.

You'll sit at the intersection of data, process, and execution; you'll turn real sales challenges into the tools, reports, automations, and workflows that move the numbers.
You'll help grow a business segment that serves tens of thousands of small businesses through smarter, data-driven sales strategies. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto sells health insurance.

The HI Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support two dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems.
Our work spans quotas, pipeline health, forecasting, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping 80+ sales reps operate efficiently and confidently.

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track sales performance, funnel metrics, pipeline health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear.
Partner with RevOps, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics to produce operational reporting, revenue insights, and forecasting models across the weekly forecast, monthly reviews, and QBR cadence.
Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on.
Drive AI Strategy for Sales
Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as content generation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process.
Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness.
Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity.
Process Design & Continuous Improvement
Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience.
Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows.
Operational Support & Problem-Solving
Provide day-to-day support to HI Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations.
Own account and territory administration as the business evolves, assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin automation.
Support territory, quota, and coverage planning, plus monthly sales-compensation reconciliation.
Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication
Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress.
Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements.
Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems.

5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use.
Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets.
Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs.
Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors.
A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions.
Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability.
A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities.

Experience in payroll, HR tech, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions.
Experience supporting a regulated or compliance-driven sales segment such as health insurance or benefits.
Experience designing or implementing automations, AI workflows, or similar tooling.
A track record of building cross-functional relationships across Sales, BizTech, and Analytics.
Experience building systems to support new or evolving sales motions, with comfort in fast iteration and testing in live sales environments.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.
We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

In this role, you will lead a team of Verification Risk Operations Associates dedicated to managing higher‑tier support and internal escalations. Your team will assess onboarding possibilities from a verification and compliance perspective, collaborating closely with Product and Engineering to ensure seamless integration of new users. As subject matter experts in user onboarding and verifications, you will drive initiatives that enhance our verification and risk management capabilities.
You will develop a deep, technical understanding of Stripe’s user verifications and compliance policies, systems, controls, and design mechanisms to deliver process improvements and an enhanced customer experience. You will own a prioritized roadmap of verification and compliance improvements and influence Policy, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to move those changes from proposal to production.
As a people manager, you will hire, coach, and develop a team of Operations Associates, set team goals, and use metrics and qualitative signals to measure and guide performance. To be a fit, you will have a strong operations mindset, be comfortable with technical systems and cross‑functional influence, be skilled at navigating ambiguity, and be passionate about delivering an incredible user verification experience while enabling business growth and managing risk.

Recruit, manage, coach, and develop a team of in-office Verification Risk Operations Associates
Guide your team to handle verifications-related user facing escalations and support internal teams with complex inquiries, guiding cross-functional teams on how to navigate network compliance rules
Drive strong operational delivery and process improvement helping to maintain risk detection strategies and business rules that balance risk and customer experience
Build a great culture and ensure team members are happy, effective, and growing in their career
Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members’ performance
Be data-driven in your analysis of performance, and in your decision making
Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment

Operational background including new process launches / improvements and service delivery

Lalamove is disrupting the logistics industry by connecting customers and drivers directly through our technology. We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it!

Currently, Lalamove is a leading global on-demand delivery platform with millions of delivery partners serving millions of orders everyday. With 1600+ employees spread across SEA and LATAM, our 10-year old company has reached unicorn status in 2018, is well funded by prominent VCs and has kept growing at tremendous speed since.

Our strength lies in our internal values, namely Passion in serving local communities, empowering SMEs and our driver partners, Execution and Grit because that is how we differentiate ourselves by never giving up and striving for excellence, and Humility - awareness in ourselves to learn from others and never stop improving.

At Lalamove, we strongly believe in the power of community. Millions of drivers and customers use our technology every day to connect with one another and move things that matter. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple.

Since 2013, we have tackled the logistics industry head on to find the most innovative solutions for the world’s delivery needs. Our vision is to bring communities closer and make city life easier by allowing fast and convenient circulation of goods.

We realize this vision with a ‘glocal’ approach, building a robust operations team to adapt our product to local networks of businesses and delivery contractors. At the same time, we have ambition to build an international brand by establishing an even more global presence.

Liaising with drivers and clients to ensure that deliveries are out and track shipment according to clients’ requirements
Partner with driver operations team to coordinate on logistics personnel(e.g. truck drivers) according to availabilities and requirements for projects
Prepare EOD report and invoices when required for client and local team
Arrange same-day deliveries for events and projects
Attend to clients' request and assist with claims for additional charges
Assist with sorting and packing whenever necessary

Familiar with G-Suite

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact.

As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need - and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across Musculoskeletal, Women’s Health, Cardiometabolic, and Mental Health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience.

More than 1 million members across three continents have completed over 15 million AI sessions, helping 2,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs.

Backed by 59 clinical studies, 43 patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

Role

Sword Health is seeking a Partner Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of a portfolio of partner relationships. This is an individual-contributor role with direct accountability for how partnerships actually run day to day: configuration, billing, integrations, implementations, escalations, and account business reviews.

The right candidate brings the operational rigor to run complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships end to end, and the judgment to know when to resolve something directly and when to escalate it.

AI Proficiency at Sword Health
AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword Health. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

What you'll be doing

Own the operational execution for an assigned partner portfolio: configuration, file feeds, billing, integrations, and reporting.
Lead implementations and ongoing operational work for new and existing partners, coordinating internally to keep commitments on track.
Run partner-level escalations to resolution, looping in Partner Sales, Product, Client and Data Operations, or Customer Success as needed.
Own account/partner business review prep and delivery for your portfolio.
Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for partner and partner-customer stakeholders.
Partner closely with Partner Sales, Client and Data Operations, Product, and Customer Success to keep partnerships running smoothly and flag risk early.

What you need to have

Experience owning complex operational workflows for external partners or clients: billing, integrations, data or file feeds, or similar systems-level work.
Comfort operating across ambiguity with multiple internal and external stakeholders, without needing a defined playbook for every situation.
Strong analytical and critical thinking foundation: you reason from facts, synthesize clearly, and communicate with brevity.
High initiative and sound judgment: you identify what matters and act without waiting to be directed.
A track record of building trust directly with external partners or customers, not just internal stakeholders.
Direct, ongoing accountability for an external-facing relationship (client, partner, or vendor) as a standing responsibility, not a one-time project -- this is what separates someone ready for live, recurring partner ops from a general internal-ops background.

What we'd love to see

Experience in health plans, digital health, or the partner/benefits ecosystem.
Familiarity with partner or channel operations models (implementation, contracting handoff, ongoing account management).
Experience with billing, data integration, or technical operations in a client- or partner-facing role.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
As a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta, you'll combine hands-on operational ownership with strategic problem solving to help shape the future of our Partner business.
The GTM Strategy & Operations team partners with Sales and Channel leadership to design the processes, systems, governance, and insights that enable predictable, scalable revenue growth. We're building the operational infrastructure that helps our go-to-market teams move faster today while positioning the business to scale tomorrow.
In this role, you'll start by owning key day-to-day Channel Operations to develop a deep understanding of the business. From there, you'll partner closely with Channel leadership and GTM Operations to identify opportunities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build scalable solutions that improve the partner experience, simplify how we operate, and support Vanta's long-term growth.
What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:
Become the operational backbone for Vanta's Partner business by owning core day-to-day Channel Operations while developing a deep understanding of our GTM motion, systems, and partner ecosystem.
Partner closely with Channel leadership, GTM Operations, Business Systems, Finance, and Marketing to evolve Vanta's long-term Channel operating model and operational strategy.
Lead high-impact strategic initiatives across the partner ecosystem, including partner programs, deal registration, partner attribution, Rules of Engagement, pricing strategy, territory and account governance, and partner lifecycle management.
Design and implement scalable processes, governance, and reporting that reduce operational complexity while improving the experience for sellers and partners.
Translate ambiguous business problems into clear operational recommendations, balancing immediate business needs with long-term scalability.
Build trusted relationships across the business by serving as both a hands-on operator and a strategic thought partner to Channel leadership.
Drive initiatives from strategy through execution, measuring outcomes and continuously improving how Vanta operates.

8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Channel Operations, Partner Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a related function within a B2B SaaS organization.
Proven ability to balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic thinking, using operational insights to design scalable solutions that improve how the business operates.
Demonstrated success designing and evolving Channel Operations programs, including areas such as deal registration, partner attribution, partner programs, Rules of Engagement, territory and account governance, partner lifecycle management, or related GTM processes.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into clear operational strategies and measurable business outcomes.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Channel, RevOps, Finance, Systems, and Marketing.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.
Experience partnering closely with Business Systems and Analytics teams to build scalable processes, reporting, and operational infrastructure.
Proficiency with Salesforce and modern GTM technologies; experience with partner ecosystem tools or PRM platforms is a plus.
Previous experience in Channel Sales or Channel Account Management is a plus and provides valuable perspective on the partner experience.
Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoys building new capabilities, challenging the status quo, and continuously improving existing operations.

Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.
Merchandising Operations Manager
Grove's merchandising operation is full of good instincts running on manual work. This role exists to fix that: redesign the core processes, then personally build the automation that makes them stick. This is a rare shot at rebuilding how merchandising actually runs, and at proving AI belongs in the hands of the person closest to the problem, not just the AI team.
We're not hiring someone to write a strategy memo about AI and hand it off. We're hiring someone who will map the workflow, feel where it breaks, and then sit down and build the thing that fixes it.
More About the Opportunity
Merchandising at Grove runs on real expertise and too much manual glue.
Buyers chase vendors for the same data, week after week.
Marketing launches promotions inventory finds out about too late.
Good people spend their time on work a workflow should be doing for them.
We have an internal AI team. They coach. They don't build for you.
This role is for the person who wants their hands on the keyboard, not the person who scopes it and waits.
The honest version: no template here. You're defining the standard as you go, with review at key milestones and real autonomy in between.
Some of what you build will work on the first try. Some won't. That's the job.
What You'll Own
Map how merchandising actually works today, not how the org chart says it works.
Redesign core operating processes for speed, accuracy, and margin protection: assortment planning, item setup, pricing and markdown, vendor and PO management, allocation, replenishment.
Own the calendar connecting marketing activations to inventory, so launches are stock-backed, not a surprise to the warehouse.
Translate activation plans into buy, allocation, and replenishment signals; flag stock risk before launch, not after.
Coordinate vendor commitments tied to activations: fill rates, lead times, launch quantities.
Build self-service tools and proactive alerts that scale the buyer-vendor relationship, including visibility into vendor performance.
Build the automation yourself, using Claude and comparable AI tools, no/low-code platforms, and lightweight automation, from concept through rollout.
Run pilots end to end: scope, build, test for accuracy, validate fit, scale. Keep humans in the loop on margin- and inventory-critical decisions.
Maintain a registry of approved tools and active automations, so what exists and what it's for is never a mystery.
Own change management for every rollout: training, AI literacy for non-technical audiences, office hours, a bench of power users.
Build reporting on process and automation performance, and use it to prioritize what gets built next.

Real fluency in retail merchandising operations, not an adjacent function you've watched from a distance.
You've mapped a broken process and redesigned it, not just diagnosed it.
Basic technical acumen and a genuine willingness to build, no engineering background required.
Comfortable working with a specialist team as a coaching resource, not a build team, and taking their guidance without handing off your job.
You've run a pilot from scoping through adoption, and you know the gap between a demo and something people actually use.
You care about the boring, durable stuff: documentation, SOPs, registries, training, the things that outlast the person who built them.
You think in workflows and root causes, not tickets.
You know the difference between a problem worth automating and one worth leaving alone.
Even Better if You Have
Built something with Claude or a comparable AI tool that a non-technical team now relies on.

Designed a self-service tool that measurably cut manual buyer-vendor back-and-forth.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are looking for an experienced General Manager who has successfully built and led sales and technical teams. The GM will be responsible for the overall UK strategy and deliverables, in line with company priorities. We are looking for an execution-focused operator who can propel ElevenLabs in the market.

Develop and execute our UK country strategy, including sales, customer delivery, KPI setting and hiring
Design the optimal pipeline to reach our ambitious sales targets on the B2B side. In this sense, you will be expected to lead interactions with the top 30 strategic accounts in the market
Hire the founding country team responsible for sales and implementations
Define event priorities and where to invest for brand awareness
Represent ElevenLabs in events and media appearances
Work with the partner ecosystem to generate new collaborations and sales opportunities, in partnership with the global BD team
Ideate, own and drive big bets in the UK

15+ years of experience leading teams and highly complex projects
Background in consulting and sales
Deep expertise in deploying technical products and/or solutions to enterprises
Owner mentality. Hands-on and self-starter who is keen to get their hands dirty to produce results
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
A hands-on leader who thinks outside the box and wants to generate results
Proven ability to build and scale high-performing teams
Established professional network across the UK enterprise and B2B landscape

Process Overview Global Markets Global Valuation Group (GVG) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for providing valuation and independent price verification methodology support to Business Finance & Control (BFC) teams for execution of IPV, calculation of valuation adjustments and prudential valuation adjustments.

The team is also responsible for reporting and governance across all valuation processes. Additionally, the team works on a number of regulatory deliverables related to valuations and drives the overall valuation control automation agenda in partnership with Technology and other stakeholders.

The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, business finance controllers, market risk, quantitative risk and technology teams to drive the control agenda across the business.

Job Description We are looking to hire a seasoned leader in the Global Valuations Group to project manage number of regulatory deliverables for GM & GCIB Finance organization. The person will be responsible for planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases.

They will be required to manage stakeholders from different divisions within the bank to ensure that right responsibilities are allocated to right teams and the teams deliver on those in a timely fashion.

They will be helping the team put together regulatory submissions, will track progress and milestones, escalate risks as needed and facilitate issue resolution.

Given this role will be part of the valuations group and will involve interactions with senior management of technical functions, we need the person to have a deep understanding of all regulatory guidelines (like CCAR stress testing, Prudential Valuation guidelines from a PRA and ECB perspective, ICAAP etc.).

Additionally, they should also have a good knowledge of financial products and their valuations. Ideally, this role will best suit a person who has already been managing such technical regulatory projects for multiple years.

Responsibilities Planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases Stakeholder management including ensuring adequate ownership and responsibilities of the different parties involved End to end project management of regulatory deliverables including putting together submissions, tracking of progress and milestone, escalation of risks and issues and facilitating issue resolution Providing upward communication on project progress to CFO senior leadership Ensuring high quality outputs from SME team by setting standards and providing guidance on expectations Interpret regulatory changes and engage with CFO teams to perform impact assessments and drive change so that we are compliant with the new changes Put together technical presentations in partnership with CFO teams Drive the operational excellence agenda, ensuring process standardization, controls maturity, and continuous improvement across business-critical activities.

Drive valuation related projects such as market data assessment for various asset classes, back-testing of results as per regulatory guidelines, drive intra-month prices testing of results etc.

Manage the overall Model governance process for valuation related models Identify, document, and assess AI opportunities; collaborate with Technology, FLUs, and SMEs to evaluate feasibility, ROI, risk considerations, and operational impact.

Ensure adherence to AI use-case governance, including risk alignment, model-development documentation, compliance with enterprise AI policies, and responsible-AI practices. Govern technology and change portfolios, ensuring transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery accountability.

Requirements Education Graduate/ Postgraduate in Finance/Management from Tier I/II institute Experience Range 12-18 years of relevant experience in finance domain related to project management of quantitative/technical regulatory projects or Valuations / Valuation Governance Foundational skills Good understanding of regulatory landscape (Prudential valuation guidelines, ICAAP, CCAR, Valuation principles) Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines (existing and forthcoming) and identify gaps/perform impact assessments Strong project management skills with prior experience of running end to end project management for regulatory engagements ideally for large banks Strong organization and structured thinking Strong communication skills to be able to present to a highly technical and senior audience Strong written communication skills and dashboarding skills Good knowledge of global markets products along with basic risk and valuation principles Attention to details and rigor to meet expectations or internal audit and supervisor requirements.

Ability to work under tight deadlines Strong technology skills (understanding of automation tools such as Alteryx) and understanding of AI tools to enable identification and implementation of OPEX opportunities Experience working with Technology partners on architecture discussions, feasibility assessments, and solution design Additional skills Prior experience leading engagement with model governance and awareness of model governance life cycle Hands on experience with coding (ex: Python) Hands on experience in managing AI projects at large scale Strong understanding of Market risk and valuation principles.

Prior experience performing market data assessment and working with vendors on assessing quality of data Work Timings 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST Job Location* Mumbai/Gurgaon

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are looking for a passionate and results-driven General Manager - UAE who will be responsible for developing and executing the overall strategy for the UAE. As a key member of the leadership team, you will own the UAE strategy & execution, build a world-class culture, and ensure our Middle East business aligns with and contributes to our overall business strategy and goals.

· Revenue Growth Strategy & Targets : Develop and execute a comprehensive revenue growth strategy to meet the company’s goals in the UAE market.

· Market Analysis : Conduct in-depth market research to identify growth opportunities and assess the competitive landscape.

· Lead Generation : Devise strategies to generate high-quality leads and convert them into sales.

· Sales Pipeline Management : Manage the sales pipeline to ensure a steady flow of opportunities and strong conversion rates.

· Client and Partner Relationships : Build strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders to promote ongoing business.

· Brand Positioning : Ensure that the ElevenLabs brand is effectively positioned in the UAE market to attract and retain clients.

· Team Building : Recruit, train, and manage a high-performing sales and business development team.

· Performance Management : Implement performance metrics and conduct regular reviews to ensure the team meets or exceeds targets.

· Process Optimization : Identify and implement process improvements to enhance sales efficiency and effectiveness.

Our team members strive for excellence, support one another, take ownership of their results, and enjoy exploring uncharted territory. To succeed in this environment, the following qualities are essential:

· You are passionate about voice and audio AI, with a drive to make content more accessible and push the boundaries of emerging technology.

· 10+ years of experience in tech, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership or GM role.

· Extensive knowledge working in the UAE

· Proven track record of owning and growing a regional P&L.

· Strong understanding of AI/SaaS technologies and their commercial applications.

· Experience leading cross-functional teams in a high-growth or startup environment.

· Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

· Analytical mindset with strong decision-making and problem-solving ability.

· Fluency in English, Arabic is a plus

· Based out of the UAE

Role Overview Maneva is seeking a People & Business Operations Manager to build and lead our people operations function at a critical stage of growth.

Key Responsibilities U.S. Employment Compliance Own state-by-state compliance as Maneva expands its U.S. employee base: tax registration, payroll setup, mandatory workplace posters, and required employee notices, all of which vary by state.

Build and maintain a repeatable process for evaluating new-state requirements as hiring expands, rather than handling each state reactively. Partner with Rippling, outside counsel, and Finance to ensure payroll, tax, and notice obligations are met on schedule for every state in which Maneva has employees.

Serve as Maneva 's go-to internal expert on U.S. state employment law as it applies to a distributed, remote-first workforce. Own and maintain levelling frameworks across engineering (IC1–IC6) and non-technical roles; define competencies, expectations, and progression criteria, building on the framework already in place. Partner with department heads and the Talent Manager to calibrate performance data and inform talent decisions.

Compensation Administration Own day-to-day execution of compensation administration across all job levels and geographies; maintain salary bands.

Execute variable/commission plans for sales and other roles; ensure alignment with business goals. Execute ROE submissions, payroll adjustments, and comp/commission payouts, routing every payout through Finance for cost sign-off. Own employee handbook and policy management for both Canada and the U.S.; refresh as laws and entities change. Manage people-related compliance: ROE submissions, payroll tax filings, and employment law compliance across all jurisdictions.

Maintain data integrity across HRIS systems; ensure clean records for auditing. Coordinate with external employment counsel as needed. Monitor and report on employee engagement signals; identify retention risks. Facilitate communication between leadership and employees. Systems, Automation & Operations Build automated workflows. Create dashboards and reporting for leadership on key HR metrics. Manage systems integration; ensure clean data flow between platforms.

Take ownership of ad-hoc projects and strategic initiatives. Assist with insurance requirements and vendor/partnership coordination as needed.

Calm under pressure; ability to manage ambiguity, shifting priorities, and organizational change — including flexing between People Ops and BizOps work as needed. Attention to detail and compliance rigor. Clear communication; ability to explain HR and compliance concepts to non-experts.

Passion for building cultures where people feel valued and connected to mission. Technical Skills & Tools Proficiency with HRIS systems (Rippling preferred). Comfort building automation tools. Strong Excel and analytics skills. Nice to Have Experience in B2B SaaS, deep tech, or AI/manufacturing.

The Bureau of Human Resources proposes a structured, project-based student volunteer initiative within the Records and Information Management branch of the Office of Talent Services (HR/TS/RIM) at the U.S. Department of State.

This initiative directly supports the Presidential Management Agenda and Department priorities related to standardizing systems, eliminating data silos, and reducing wasteful processes.

Student volunteers will contribute to clearly defined, outcome-driven projects, including the documentation of standard procedures, conducting process mapping and proposing innovative modernizations, and updating SharePoint and ServiceNow systems with relevant information.

These efforts address a legitimate agency need to increase efficiencies as well as improve the usability, discoverability, and preservation of operational documents while supporting broader federal data and records management objectives.

The project is designed to align with student learning objectives by providing hands-on experience in process mapping and improvement, writing in Plain Language, lean management practices, and digital records management, while strengthening technical, analytical, and critical thinking skills.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

In this role you will influence commercial success, providing an outstanding opportunity for career growth and visibility within our commercial and sales operations organizations! The candidate must work closely with internal customers and current team members to implement sales strategies and achieve business goals. Having analytical skills, business insight, good judgement, accountability and the ability to collaborate will be essential to growth in a multifaceted, cross-functional setting.
What will you do?
Support sales incentive compensation for North American Laboratory Products field sales teams.
Involvement in sales compensation plan design for team members who are eligible under the Sales Incentive Plans (SIP).
Review monthly incentive compensation payouts, revenue adjustments and performance.
Involvement in month-end reporting and preparation of revenue data reports for monthly review.
Ensure accurate data quality and maintenance in the Sales Data Warehouse and Xactly Incent.
Help coordinate the Sales Rep Product/Channel responsibility matrix, ensuring accurate implementation and documentation of changes.
Support the Sales Territory Management process, including territory mapping and documentation.
Provide ad-hoc reporting and insights to the teams you support.

Candidate must present an approachable, highly ethical and collaborative mindset. In sales operations, we demonstrate personal accountability for accuracy and timeliness of results. You must be a proactive communicator, addressing issues with transparency and urgency. We successfully operate by building credibility and positive professional relationships, where strong commercial orientation and experience supporting sales teams is a plus.
The candidate must have outstanding analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills, while being self-motivated with a high bias for action and accountability. Having the ability to balance priorities, bring high energy and have a passion for excelling will be a crucial part of your success in this role.

BA/BS degree in finance, accounting or a related business field (MBA a plus)
Minimum of 3+ years of increasingly responsible business experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Support, or Financial Analyst Role supporting cross-functional teams
Strong proficiency in Excel. Experience with the following: Cognos (or equivalent data warehouse tool), Xactly Incent (or equivalent compensation management tool), and PowerPoint are a strong plus
Ability to travel to corporate events as needed

The salary range estimated for this position based in New York is $60,000.00–$90,000.00.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:
A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount
For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

Why WestJet
Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.
Join us, this is where your career story takes off.
This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.
Regional General Manager, Airports
As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.
This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.
The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.
Key Deliverables Include
Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.

s.h: Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
s.t:
Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
Project management skills considered an asset.
Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

s.h: The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter
s.t:
WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:
A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs
Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!
About WestJet Group Of Companies
WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent.

Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia.

The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.
Our safety promise
At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others.

WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk.

All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy.
Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.
